projectContext: Sprint 24 continues test infrastructure improvements after Sprint 23 completed research client tests, compilation builder tests, marker audits, and subdirectory fixtures. This sprint focuses on documentation gaps (4 test subdirectories lack README files), parameterized test expansion (only 26 files use @parametrize), flaky test infrastructure, benchmark CI integration, test helper utilities, and coverage reporting improvements. Target: complete test infrastructure maturity before transitioning to other focus areas.
